liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer highlights the transition from Dark Star to The Other One as a standout; Reviewer calls the sixty-minute jam the show's finest symphonic improvisation example [11][12]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-02-13.sbd.miller.97613.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 228 min; rated 5/5 by 12 [1]
- **gd1970-02-13.sbd.miller.fix-97613.97639.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 228 min; rated 4.64/5 by 22 [2]. Said about its sound: Digital noise was fixed in the Little Sadie section of the recording [2]
- **gd1970-02-13.176321.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 24 songs; 229 min [3]
- **gd1970-02-13.123814.aud.cooper.flac16**: audience recording; 25 songs; 166 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [4]

## Around the show

- Jam includes references to other songs and snatches of Simon & Garfunkel's 59th Street [12]
- Reviewer notes the absence of official outtakes from these specific shows [13]
- David Gans aired about ninety minutes of unreleased music from these dates on KPFA [18]
- Reviewer questions why the acoustic set and early show leftovers are missing from the site [20]
- Reviewer asks why the complete soundboards for both nights are not yet available [21]
- The late show was played in electric, acoustic, and electric segments [3]
- The late show was played in electric, acoustic, and electric segments [4]
- Reviewer argues this show is the only one to feature both key jam tunes together [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-02-13.sbd.miller.97613.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Rob Eaton lent the Dats used for the transfer of this recording; Uncle John's Band is patched from shnid=18114 and is also cut [1]
- **gd1970-02-13.sbd.miller.fix-97613.97639.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k) [2]. Also: Rob Eaton lent the Dats used for the transfer of this recording [2]
- **gd1970-02-13.176321.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 13, 2026; source: SBD > Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) > DAT (48k) [3]. Also: Rob Eaton provided the tapes used for this specific recording transfer [3]
- **gd1970-02-13.123814.aud.cooper.flac16**: taped by Jim Cooper; source: Late show. Recorded by Jim Cooper from seat # BB 108 (2nd row Center) Hitachi trq-222, 2 Hitachi mikes; Transferred > sony d5pro2 > dbx 2231 EQ > sony rcd w500c [4]
